title: herniaria glabra subsp. rotundifolia
intro: Herniaria glabra subsp. rotundifolia, commonly known as Rough Leak or Kidney Trefoil, is a plant species belonging to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as diuretic and anti-inflammatory effects, which may aid in treating urinary issues and reducing swelling. The therapeutic actions of Herniaria glabra subsp. rotundifolia include its ability to act as a diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it a potential treatment for various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
